label: Presidential Approval Rating
source: Bloomberg LatAm Pulse / multiple pollsters, end-April 2026
deltaNote: Peaked at 85% Feb 2025; fell to 72% Mar 2026; 54% Mar 2026; now 51% — lowest of presidency. Driven by Q1 GDP contraction (-0.8%), CIA-Chihuahua sovereignty crisis, DOJ indictment of Sinaloa governor, and economic anxiety.

label: Homicide Rate (per 100k)
source: SNSP / INEGI; SSPC García Harfuch, Martes de Seguridad May 12, 2026
contestNote: Through Apr 2026: daily intentional homicide avg fell 40% since Oct 2024 inauguration (86.9/day → 52.5/day). Mar 2026 lowest monthly count since 2015. Critics note: disappearances still rising; Sinaloa up ~400%; 800+ families displaced by Los Ardillos drone attacks in Guerrero (May 2026). Government disputed on methodology.
delta: -40% daily avg since Oct 2024 inauguration (86.9→52.5/day through Apr 2026)

label: Total Homicides (2025)
contestNote: Lowest since 2016 but disappearances up 16% vs AMLO final year; six states saw homicide increases

label: GDP Growth (2025 actual / Q1 2026 / 2026 full-year forecast)
source: INEGI Q1 2026 preliminary (Apr 30); Citi Encuesta de Expectativas, May 21, 2026
contestNote: Q1 2026 INEGI preliminary: -0.8% quarterly, +0.2% annual. All three sectors declined. Full-year 2026 forecasts: Citi survey (May 21) 1.1% — lowest consensus estimate; IMF 1.6%; BBVA 1.8%; govt 1.8–2.8%. USMCA renegotiation uncertainty is the primary drag on new investment.
delta: 2026 full-year forecast cut to 1.1% (Citi May 21); Q1 actual: -0.8% QoQ
deltaNote: Q1 all sectors contracted: primary -1.4%, secondary -1.1%, tertiary -0.6%. $17.4B in investment held due to tariff uncertainty. Citi consensus lowest since 2020.

label: Annual Inflation
source: INEGI, first fortnight May 2026 (announced Sheinbaum mañanera May 22, 2026)
delta: -0.34pp vs full April 2026 (4.45%); -0.16pp vs second half April. Attributed partly to fuel price freeze agreement with gas station owners and electricity subsidy. Monthly deceleration continuing into Q2 2026.

label: FDI (Jan–Sep 2025)
contestNote: Headline FDI record; critics note new greenfield investment dropped 34% to $3.17B in 2024; most is reinvestment by existing companies

label: Banxico Policy Rate
source: Banco de México official press release, May 7, 2026; Bloomberg
delta: -475bp from 11.25% peak; 15th consecutive cut; 3-2 split vote May 7, 2026. Board guidance: easing cycle is over — 'appropriate to maintain at current level.' No further cuts expected through 2027.

label: Peso / USD Exchange Rate
source: Banxico FIX / Citi Encuesta de Expectativas, May 22, 2026
delta: ~17.33 MXN/USD week of May 22, mild depreciation from 17.29 (May 8); year-end consensus 18.0 per Citi (May 21). Banxico rate at 6.50% supports carry trade; USMCA uncertainty a mild headwind.
